name: @zsms/auth-provider
//exports: Four entry points, split by execution context rather than by topic. `.` is server-only and safe to import from a Node worker. `./middleware` pulls in Clerk's edge runtime and belongs to exactly one file in apps/web. `./react` re-exports client components. `./organisations` is Backend-API administration and needs CLERK_SECRET_KEY, so it is server-only and deliberately separate from `.`; `./impersonation` is the same, kept apart again because minting a token that lets one person act as another is a sharper capability than inviting somebody — a worker importing the session helper must not pull in a client that can invite people. Keeping them apart means importing the session helper into a background worker does not drag React along with it.
